Looking for an attractive and functional personal item bag that fits under your seat on an airplane and straps onto your carry-on luggage? In this video, I review the Nordace Siena Weekender Tote bag. #luggage #weekenderbag

This is my new Nord Dash Sienna Weekender that I got because I want to take it on a trip abroad and I really love it. You can fit this underneath the seat in an airplane which is really important and it just carries so much. Look how fat it is right now because I have it all packed up for the weekend. Just want to show you a couple of things. It's got a little key holder like this. I really like that. And it has a little power station right here so you can charge your phone, which I think is really cool, too. And then on this side of it, it has the little trolley strap that you can stick it over your luggage. And I would show you how that works, except that I didn't bring it with me. So anyway, so you can unzip it here. It's got these little snaps here if you want to make it more compact here. I have it so filled up that I couldn't do that, but as you can see, it holds a lot of stuff. So, I've got my toiletries. I've got a bunch of clothes all wrapped up in here. Just going to take everything out really quick so I can show you what's inside. As you can see, I have a lot of stuff in here. Yummies. It's got a wet bag right here. This is really great cuz if you have a wet bathing suit or something that's really wet and you don't have time to dry it, you can just stick it in there. Then it's got a laptop sleeve right here. So, you can stick a laptop in here. I don't have it with me, but as you can see, it's right here. And what else is it have? It has so many things. This is the power cord that comes out this end. I think that's really neat. It's got like I can show you in here. It's got a little elastic pocket in here that you can stick a water bottle, which is very important. right here. It's got places you could put your credit cards and hope you can see that. Yeah. And there's various other flaps so you could put your cell phone or whatever else you've got in there. And it's just got a ton of room in here. And so I'm really going to like it when I go on my next trip. And it's pretty. It comes in a bunch of different colors. So, if you're looking for a weekender bag, this is nice and soft, you know, so it can squish and fit anywhere. It's not hard and rigid. And so, I think that's important. And then it's got these straps right here. And it's got a little hook so you can hook something on there if you need to. And oh, I hope I'm not missing anything. Oh, it's got a little secret pocket in here. So, it's just got all kinds of little pockets and areas that you can organize all your stuff.
